models_evaluated: four state-of-the-art LLMs (not named in text)

links.outcome: association of clinician-rated reasoning quality with diagnostic correctness in LLM psychiatric diagnosis
links.effect: Reasoning quality strongly associated with diagnostic correctness (β = 1·80; p < 0·001); data extraction quality alone was not. Best model top-5 accuracy 0·801.
links.quote: Clinician-rated diagnostic reasoning quality was strongly associated with diagnostic correctness in mixed-effects logistic regression analyses (β = 1·80; p < 0·001), whereas data extraction quality alone was not.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating clinician-visible LLM diagnostic reasoning traces with structured clinician ratings, beyond accuracy metrics

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical reasoning traces of four LLMs using psychiatric clinical vignettes rated by psychiatrists, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
